topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: When you receive account statements and confirmations, you should always verify that the information in them is correct.
answer: When opening a brokerage account, you can choose whether to receive account statements and trade confirmations on paper or electronically. These records help you keep track of account activity. Review them and check that the information is correct. If you have questions, notice an error, or see a transaction you did not make or authorize, contact your brokerage firm immediately by phone and in writing. You may also consider having someone you trust receive duplicate statements and confirmations.
